title: Footprints in the Hall
story:
On Monday morning the school hall was muddy. A line of footprints ran from the side door to the art cupboard. Each print was small and showed a star on the heel. The caretaker, Idris, closed the hall and called Maya and Tom, who had arrived early. Nothing was broken, but a box of new brushes was missing.

Maya thought about the art club. Only one member, Ben, had shoes with a star on the heel, and Ben had wanted those brushes for a weekend poster. They found him in the library with paint on his sleeve. Tom watched the prints while Maya asked the questions. He said he had not entered the hall. Maya asked him to show his shoe. The sole was clean, and there was no star.

They followed the prints back outside. A younger pupil, Aisha, was washing her shoes at a tap. The sole showed a star, and mud still clung to it. She began to cry. She had taken the brushes to finish a class sign, and she had been too scared to bring them back. The brushes were in her bag and were still clean. Idris thanked her for the truth and walked with her to return the box. Aisha said she would ask before she borrowed class things again. The brushes were back in the cupboard before the first lesson. The muddy hall had a simple answer.

quiz.question: Where did the line of footprints go?
options: From the side door to the art cupboard
From the library to the outside tap
From the hall to Ben's house
From the cupboard to the office
